source_description_html:
The Quad Lock® Handlebar Mount is the ultimate smartphone mount for motorcycles, compatible with all Quad Lock® Cases including the Quad Lock® Universal Adaptor for other Android phone devices.

The Quad Lock® Handlebar Mount gives you the flexibility to mount your phone in a convenient and visible location using a rotating head and includes an extension arm if extra clearance is required. With your phone securely mounted to your motorcycle, you can use navigation apps to guide you to your location with ease and always stay connected.

  • Secure - Patented Dual Stage Locking Mount
  • Convenient - Use Navigation Apps on the go
  • Discrete - Small mount size
  • Multiple Mounting configurations (360 degree arm rotation)
  • Suits bar sizes ⅞” (22mm), 1” (25mm), 1-⅛” (28mm), 1-¼” (32mm)
  • Compatible will all Quad Lock Cases and the Universal Adaptor
